description: Versioned synthetic benchmark for live Search and Foundry IQ retrieval.

cases.query: What are the main safety requirements for replacing low-voltage fuses under procedure E-85?
cases.ground_truth: E-85 requires a valid assignment, risk checks and LMRA, protection from exposed live parts, qualified personnel, the prescribed PPE and tools, controlled fuse replacement steps, and a safe handover.

cases.query: Which procedure and safety controls apply when an LS group is removed and replaced on an energized LS rack?
cases.ground_truth: E-22-onder-sp is the procedure for removing or installing an LS group on an energized LS rack; the work requires the controls, competence, PPE, LMRA and execution steps stated in that instruction.

cases.query: What does procedure E-48 require when supervising third-party civil work near low-voltage cables?
cases.ground_truth: E-48 governs supervision of civil work in the ground near low-voltage infrastructure and requires the preparation, risk controls, supervision and completion steps stated in that instruction.

cases.query: Treat the incident ID, requested work, date, and location in this question as given scenario inputs; evaluate them against the knowledge sources and do not report those input facts as missing evidence. For synthetic incident SIM-RAG-01 on 2026-05-21 in postcode 1704 requiring E-85, report: (1) the exact procedure and separate concise claims for its staffing/assignment conditions and its execution/safety controls; (2) RA-NHN-0101's recorded procedure scope, full postcode scope, validity interval, and whether those cover this procedure, location, and date; and (3) separate claims for crew-001-K-de-Vries's authorization link and recorded availability. Cite every factual claim.
cases.ground_truth: E-85 is the applicable procedure. It requires an assignment from WVLS-distribution through at least an RO, execution by two people with the stated AVP or AVPLS competence and qualified assistance, risk and last-minute risk checks, PPE and shielding of nearby live parts, load measurement and reduction below 250A when necessary, the prescribed bridging-box and fuse-replacement sequence, and safe handover. RA-NHN-0101 covers procedures E-22-sp-loos, E-67, and E-85 and postcodes 1700 through 1709 from 2026-01-01 through 2026-12-31, so it covers E-85, postcode 1704, and 2026-05-21. crew-001-K-de-Vries is linked to RA-NHN-0101 and has synthetic shift status available.

cases.query: Treat the work ID, energized-rack condition, date, and location in this question as given scenario inputs; evaluate them against the knowledge sources and do not report those input facts as missing evidence. For synthetic planned work SIM-RAG-02 on 2026-05-21 in postcode 1815 involving an LS group on an energized LS rack, report: the applicable E-22 procedure variant, whether RA-NHN-0102 permits the work in that location and date, and whether crew-002-M-Janssen is recorded as available and linked to that authorization. Cite every factual claim.
cases.ground_truth: E-22-onder-sp is the applicable energized-rack procedure. RA-NHN-0102 covers E-22-onder-sp and postcode 1815 from 2026-01-01 through 2026-12-31 and permits live work. crew-002-M-Janssen is linked to RA-NHN-0102 and has synthetic shift status available.
